Protein Food

Top Round

About This Entry

Top round is a lean leg cut often roasted or sliced thin for sandwiches. Its low fat content means tannic reds can taste harsh unless the meat is served with sauce, marinade, or moderate doneness with resting.

Beginner Guide

Top round is sometimes labeled London broil in US markets, though that name applies to several lean cuts. Best served medium-rare and sliced against the grain.

FAQ

What is Top Round?
Top round is sometimes labeled London broil in US markets, though that name applies to several lean cuts.
How should Top Round be cooked for best results?
Lean cuts benefit from medium-rare to medium doneness, resting before slice, and slicing against the grain — avoid overcooking which dries the meat and makes tannic wines taste harsh.
